Or maybe the goal is related to the yellow/orange halves: maybe I need to flood/convert one color to another.

<parameter=code>
def diff(t):
    A2=t.before_frame.ascii.split('\n'); B2=t.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    d=[(i,j,A2[i][j],B2[i][j]) for i in range(len(A2)) for j in range(len(A2[i])) if A2[i][j]!=B2[i][j]]
    return d
for (rr,cc,label) in [(51,21,'blueL'),(51,41,'blueR'),(30,10,'yellow'),(30,50,'orange'),(0,30,'topB'),(63,30,'botB')]:
    r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':rr,'col':cc}])
    d=diff(transitions[-1])
    print(label, r['board_changed'], len(d), d[:6], "GO" if r.get('game_over') else "")
    if r.get('game_over') or r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done'): print("STOP", r); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
